description: Building and HVAC mappings with selected published screening priors and explicit project overrides.

exergy-imperative-component-methods.applicable_boundary: Single-input building energy converters at the delivered-energy equipment boundary

doe-femp-geothermal-heat-pumps.title: U.S. DOE FEMP: Purchasing Energy-Efficient Geothermal Heat Pumps
doe-femp-geothermal-heat-pumps.license: U.S. Government work; verify page-specific third-party notices

doe-efficient-new-homes-hvac-2025.title: DOE Efficient New Homes Multifamily Version 2, Revision 2 National Program Requirements
doe-efficient-new-homes-hvac-2025.license: U.S. Government work; verify document-specific third-party notices
doe-efficient-new-homes-hvac-2025.applicable_boundary: Rated and integrated HVAC equipment efficiency criteria in the DOE Efficient New Homes national requirements
doe-efficient-new-homes-hvac-2025.note: Procurement criteria are screening benchmarks, not field or seasonal measurements. IEER values are converted to dimensionless Btu/h per watt using 3.412 Btu/Wh.

technology.label: Ground-source heat pump
technology.boundary: Heat-pump unit electricity to rated useful heating output; ground-loop pumping and other external auxiliaries are excluded unless the caller overrides COP with a system-boundary value

cop.statistic: ENERGY STAR procurement criterion; lower and upper bounds are the less-efficient comparator and best-available product in the DOE example
cop.range_basis: Procurement benchmark envelope, not an empirical confidence interval

applicability.technology: Single-phase residential geothermal heat pumps represented by the 36,000 Btu/h DOE example
applicability.boundary: Rated equipment heating output divided by equipment electrical input under ISO 13256-1; external loop pumping excluded
applicability.geography: United States federal procurement examples; the same stated COP benchmarks are used across the three listed regions

cop.note: Replace with a tested or seasonal system COP when available.

technology.label: Water-source heat pump
technology.boundary: Delivered electricity to useful space heat; source-water pumping must be included in the supplied COP

cop.statistic: DOE water-loop heat-pump heating COP criterion
cop.range_basis: Published point criterion; not an uncertainty interval

applicability.technology: Water-loop heat-pump equipment covered by the DOE program table
applicability.boundary: Rated equipment heating output divided by equipment electricity; external loop pumping excluded
applicability.geography: United States DOE Efficient New Homes program

cop.note: Use a seasonal system COP including source-water pumping when available.

technology.label: Variable-refrigerant-flow heating system
technology.boundary: Delivered electricity to useful zone heat including declared indoor and outdoor auxiliaries

cop.statistic: Midpoint of listed VRF heating COP criteria
cop.range_basis: Range across the listed DOE VRF equipment categories

applicability.technology: Variable-refrigerant-flow heat pumps covered by the DOE program table
applicability.boundary: Rated equipment heating output divided by rated equipment electricity
applicability.geography: United States DOE Efficient New Homes program

cop.note: Not a seasonal or cold-climate site COP.

technology.label: Variable-refrigerant-flow cooling system
technology.boundary: Delivered electricity to useful zone cooling including declared indoor and outdoor auxiliaries

cop.statistic: Midpoint of 16.2-16.6 IEER converted by 3.412 Btu/Wh
cop.range_basis: Range across listed DOE VRF cooling IEER criteria

applicability.technology: Variable-refrigerant-flow cooling equipment covered by the DOE program table
applicability.boundary: Integrated rated cooling output divided by equipment electricity under the IEER test procedure
applicability.geography: United States DOE Efficient New Homes program

cop.note: COP-equivalent derived from IEER; do not use as an instantaneous operating-point COP.
